description: Frozen explicit native pose inputs for the independent official-source skin/PSD/calibration oracle. No expected output points or runtime mesh positions are stored in these inputs.
units: native quaternion XYZW, pose/source surface meters relative to native root; corrective centimeters before skin

canonicalCalibration.method: Native pose quaternions are explicit test inputs. Official source PARAM/FK rotations, independent Python author FK anchors, original 8-slot weights/original source inverse binds, fixed descriptor boneScales and C_i applied equally to base+independentNPZPSD. Runtime final positions or target bone positions are never used as reference values. Helper twist semantic is tested separately; this is a source skin/PSD/calibration oracle, not a complete independent controller oracle.
canonicalCalibration.calibrationEquation: p_target=sum_i w_i W_target_i C_i inverse(B_source_i) (p_source+PSD*0.01); source meters Y-up relative native root.

historicalFirstRuntime.sourceHelperDriver: compact Euler.rx coupled directly across canonical axis schema
historicalFirstRuntime.reasonForRevisedMethod: After axial retarget, official original native skin plus independently calculated upstream PSD itself gives natural same-vertex 170 chest motion above the former unvalidated 25 mm line. Preserve source deformation and validate source parity instead of suppressing the muscle response.
